items.title: Power dissipation in an inductor (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Power dissipation in an inductor: a main subheading of 17.6 AC Through Inductor, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 95-96.

blocks.text: Pure (khalis) inductor mein average power zero hoti hai. Inductor power kharch nahi karta: yeh energy magnetic field mein jama karta hai aur demagnetisation (field khatam hone) par source ko wapas kar deta hai. Har instant (lamha) ki power upar neeche hoti hai (kabhi energy andar, kabhi bahar), lekin ek cycle ki average power zero hoti hai, kyunke V aur I mein 90° ka phase difference hai. Is liye inductor energy kharch kiye baghair AC ko control karne ke kaam aata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke inductive circuit mein instantaneous power zero hai. Yeh sahi nahi: P = VI = ½VₒIₒ sin 2ωt hai, jo ek chauthai cycle positive (energy field mein jati hai) aur agli chauthai negative (energy wapas aati hai) hoti hai. Sirf poori cycle ka average zero hai.

blocks.title: Example 17.4
blocks.problem: 400 mH ki coil (resistance na hone ke barabar) AC circuit mein lagi hai jis mein 6 mA rms current beh raha hai. Frequency 1 kHz ho to coil par rms voltage nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: L = 400 mH = 400 × 10⁻³ H = 0.4 H
Iᵣₘₛ = 6 mA = 6 × 10⁻³ A, f = 1 kHz = 1000 Hz; Vᵣₘₛ = ?

blocks.prompt: Frequency dugni karne par inductor ki reactance ka kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh bhi dugni ho jati hai, kyunke X_L = 2πfL, yani X_L frequency f ke directly proportional hai.

items: Inductor: V = Vₒ sin (ωt + π/2); voltage current se 90° aage (current peeche).
X_L = ωL = 2πfL: DC (f = 0) par zero, zyada f par bara.
